description: Log in to Gridline through the user's browser when no API key is set (a tool answered not_logged_in). The first call starts the login and returns verification_url and user_code: show both to the user and ask them to open the URL, sign in or sign up, check the code matches and click Approve. Call login again to wait for the approval (up to wait_seconds); it answers logged_in once the key is saved. The key is stored privately on this machine (the same file `gridline login` uses) and is never shown. Free: no charge.

force.description: Approve a new API key even if one is already set.

wait_seconds.description: How long a call after the first waits for the approval, 0 to 120 (default 30).

name: login
title: Log in
